A paragraph is one or more lines of text. Its lines are joined
with a space, so where the writer broke them does not matter,
and the renderer breaks them again to fit the terminal.

A second paragraph, written as a single long line the way a model writes it: the quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog, and then does it again for good measure.

A hard break after two spaces  
puts what follows on a new line, and so does a backslash\
at the end of a line, and so does a tag<br>like this one.
Spaces   inside   a line   are kept.

A well-known state-of-the-art word-with-many-hyphens can break after a hyphen, and averyveryverylongwordthatdoesnotfitonasinglenarrowlineatall is broken where the line is full.
